items.title: 13.3 Halogen molecules ke bond ki taqat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.3 with Table 13.3, printed page 294.

blocks.text: Halogens mein bond ki taqat group mein chlorine se iodine tak neeche ghat-ti hai, kyunke barhta atomic size lambe bonds aur kamzor bonds deta hai; bond energy Cl2 se I2 tak batadreej girti hai. Fluorine istisna hai: us ka bond nisbatan kamzor hai kyunke fluorine atoms bohat chhote hain, to dono atoms ke lone pairs ke darmiyan khasa dhakka hota hai (Figure 13.1 F2 molecule ko us ke lone pairs ke saath dikhati hai), jo fluorine ki oonchi electronegativity ke bawajood bond ko kamzor karta hai.

blocks.alt: Moti lakeer wala F–F. Har F ke teen narangi lone-pair lobes hain, har ek mein do sabz nuqte: ek oopar, ek neeche aur ek bahar ki taraf. Dono oopar wale lobes aur dono neeche wale lobes ke darmiyan surkh dohre teer; oopar 'lp - lp repulsion' likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.1: Lone pairs ke saath F2 molecule (kitab ke safha 294 ki Figure 13.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; kitab yeh number do dafa istemal karti hai).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Fluorine ke atoms bohat chhote hain, is liye F-F bond chhota hai aur dono atoms ke lone pairs ek doosre ke bohat qareeb aa jate hain. Teer dikhate hain ke yeh jore ek doosre ko dhakelte (repel) hain; yahi dhakka bond ko kamzor karta hai, is liye F2 ki bond energy (156 kJ mol-1) Cl2 (243) se kam hai.

blocks.prompt: F-F bond Cl-Cl bond se kamzor hai halanke fluorine sab se electronegative element hai. Wazahat karein (Quick Check 13.2a; MCQ I).
blocks.explanation: F-F bond bohat chhota hai kyunke atoms nanhe hain, to har fluorine ke teen lone pairs doosre ke qareeb aa kar zor se dhakelte hain; yeh dhakka mushtarka pair ki kashish ko kaat kar bond energy 156 kJ mol-1 tak gira deta hai. Chlorine atoms bare hain, lone pairs door hain, aur Cl2 group ka sab se mazboot bond 243 kJ mol-1 rakhta hai.

items: X-X bond energy Cl2 (243) se Br2 (193) se I2 (151 kJ mol-1) girti hai jaise atoms bare hote hain; F2 (156) be-qaida kamzor hai kyunke nanhe atoms ke darmiyan lone-pair dhakka bond ko kamzor karta hai.
